content.text:
I can't compute the yearly case counts, because the working directory has no IURC order data.

The directory holds only dotfiles and Claude configuration. The dotfiles, such as `.bashrc` and `.gitconfig`, are character device nodes, so they hold no content. There are no order PDFs, text files or spreadsheets covering the 58 orders from 2021 to 2025, and I did not look outside the working directory.

I'd only be guessing at the numbers: 58 orders over five years is about 11–12 orders a year. Each order can hold several cases, so the case counts could be much higher. I can't say which year has the most cases.

If you add the order files to the working directory, I'll count the cases per year and name the peak year.
